title: Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the historical events and leadership of the Communist Party of Vietnam in the national liberation and socialist construction movements.
Analyze the political theories and policies of the Communist Party of Vietnam.
Develop research skills to analyze historical events and political theories.
Apply critical thinking to evaluate historical events and political theories.
Improve communication skills through group work and presentations.
Work effectively in teams to analyze historical events and political theories.
Develop self-learning skills to independently study and understand historical events and political theories.

prerequisite_courses: Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học
